services.desc: "Koei-Kan" translates to "Prosperity with Happiness," embodying its essence. Koei-Kan Karate-Do's core objective is character development through disciplined training, transcending technique to encompass a holistic life approach. Visionary Master Onishi Eizo, originating from Japan, learned under modern Karate pioneers Master Toyama Kanken and Kyoda Juhatsu, pivotal in shaping today's Karate styles. Master Onishi's influence spreads through teaching and demonstrations globally, spanning Asia, Europe, Latin America, and the USA.
